scopeBoundary: Use the existing hCaptcha helper; do not add a second CAPTCHA implementation or dependency.
Obtain a fresh token immediately before each protected user-initiated request.
Never persist or log CAPTCHA tokens.
Send tokens only to same-origin /api/auth endpoints.
Do not restore direct supabase.auth calls to LoginPage.
acceptanceCriteria: Registration obtains a fresh hCaptcha token and includes captchaToken in /api/auth/register.
Email login obtains a fresh token and includes it in /api/auth/login/email.
Password recovery obtains a fresh token and includes it in /api/auth/password/forgot.
Confirmation resend obtains a fresh token and includes it in /api/auth/confirmation/resend.
The hCaptcha SDK is preloaded opportunistically without weakening fail-closed behavior.
Focused and required checks pass on exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
